description: EcoData is a student team combining engineering, programming, data analysis, embedded systems, research, and design. Our members bring diverse technical skills in front-end development, C/C++, hardware, digital logic, and problem-solving. We aim to explore space-related challenges and create practical, innovative solutions through technology, creativity, and teamwork.
summary:
Eco Data is an interactive website that turns anyone into an "Earth System Trend Detective." Using open-source NASA satellite data, our tool tracks and visualizes three major climate changes over time: rising temperatures, ice melting, and rainfall shifts. 

It solves the challenge by turning complex NASA data into simple, clear charts that show how these climates signs affect each other. Instead of looking at confusing numbers, users can easily see real trends on our planet. 

This project is important because everyone deserves to understand how our climate is changing. Eco Data makes space data simple, so students and communities can see climate risks clearly and help protect our Earth

Earth Trend Detective

https://understanding-channel-279685.framer.app/#experience

Project Description

Earth Trend Detective is an interactive scientific platform designed to explore long-term changes and patterns in Earth's systems using NASA Earth observation data and statistical analysis.

The project aims to make complex scientific datasets more accessible and understandable by transforming raw observations into meaningful analytical insights through data processing, statistical methods, and interactive visualizations.

The Problem

Earth science datasets contain valuable information about our planet, but extracting meaningful long-term patterns from these datasets can be challenging. Users may struggle to process large amounts of scientific data, identify trends, evaluate their statistical significance, and interpret the results.

Earth Trend Detective addresses this challenge by providing a structured and interactive approach to scientific data exploration and trend analysis.

Our Solution

We are developing a web-based platform that allows users to explore defined geographical study areas and investigate historical scientific observations.

The platform processes scientific datasets, applies statistical analysis techniques, detects long-term trends, and presents the findings through interactive charts, geographical visualizations, and statistical summaries.

Our approach focuses on making the analytical process transparent, understandable, and scientifically reliable.

Data Sources

Our project uses NASA Earth science resources, including:

  • NASA Giovanni
  • NASA Earth Science Data resources
